phase: Confirmatory study planned before new simulations; numerical pilot and fitting precede untouched test generation
question: Do past changes of neighboring marker arrangements improve within-time spatial prediction of later strong deformation beyond full present local velocity gradient and current geometry?
predecessor: ../full-history-refinement/completion.json; finish, verify and publish its bounded matrix first
equations: Unchanged parent3D unforced incompressible Navier–Stokes Flow, rotational nonlinearity, Fourier projection/dealiasing and joint Heun updates; periodic side6; no material-memory or marker-force term
initial_conditions: Same smooth random low-Fourier-mode polynomial and RMS speed1 normalization; entirely new independent coefficients/phases and initial marker positions
sampler: Separate periodic4-point tensor Lagrange velocity and exact piecewise spatial Jacobian; old trilinear experiment unchanged. Interpolant is not exactly divergence-free and derivatives may jump at faces.

pilot.choose: Smallest candidate80 or112 satisfying both adjacent-grid accuracy checks and its half-step checks. Grid112 requires conditional160 confirmation if80 cannot be used. Stop if no candidate passes; do not silently collect unresolved test data.

target: log(sigma_max(M_end @ inv(M_start)))/horizon over strictly future interval[anchor+.025,anchor+.025+horizon]; predict at current material-marker locations, not exact Eulerian peak or first-onset time

primary_endpoint.aggregation: AP at each of five anchors; average within each independent run; equal-weight mean over64 test runs. No-positive-event anchor has AP0 and contributes equal zero A/B difference; report counts. Pooled AP is secondary.
primary_endpoint.comparison: Fresh standardized logistic B_history minus A_full; identical regularization grid, training/validation runs and current inputs
primary_endpoint.CI: Paired whole-run percentile bootstrap10000 draws,95% two-sided, seed84017
primary_endpoint.conclusion: Useful benefit established only if lower95% bound exceeds.005 and numerical audits pass. A gain at least.005 is ruled out for this comparison if upper95% bound is below.005 and audits pass. Otherwise report detectable-small or unresolved evidence. No threshold/seed expansion after seeing test results.

secondary_continuous.interpretation: Secondary descriptive endpoint; cannot substitute for strong-event location prediction.

models.primary: Ridge/logistic, train-only scaler, validation-only hyperparameter selection; no train+validation refit
models.matched_current: 31 present plus23 fixed quadratic current terms, chosen by seed513 before data
models.trees: SecondaryA/B/matched-current all depth3,7leaves,80iterations,learning-rate.08,min-leaf40,l2 candidates1,10,early-stoppingfalse; same tuning budget
models.test_lock: Freeze and hash all selected models, thresholds, scalers, protocol and feature code before any test trajectory is generated. No model selection using test data.

controls: Fully refitted shuffled historical rows within each run/anchor, seeds91/92/93
Fully refitted mirrored histories and mirrored-reversed histories with current fluid inputs held fixed; diagnostic representation controls, not physical interventions
Consistent complete particle-ID relabeling; no ID supplied as predictor
Past-deformation-only, without past deformation, without neighbor exchange
sensitivity_policy: A/B only, all settings fitted and locked before test generation; exploratory intervals with no secondary-outcome selection of the primary conclusion

test_numerical_controls.rule: Predetermined sensitivity audits after models freeze; do not refit/retune or choose a primary grid from test outcomes. If accuracy screens fail, withhold useful-benefit/exclusion claims.

viscosity_controls.models: Frozen primaryA/B; dependent variants of four test groups, not eight new independent observations; no broad Reynolds generalization claim

simulation_budget_derivation: At most22 pilot+96 train/validation if both candidate grids needed+64 untouched primary test+4 test numerical controls+8 viscosity variants. No automatically added seeds or time extension.

bootstrap.unit: entire independent seed/run, all anchors/markers together

interpretation: Numerically audited out-of-sample comparison within this initial-condition distribution, viscosity and fixed primary window. Higher-order sampling is a separate documented method improvement, not a silent alteration of the frozen predecessor. Predictive correlations do not establish material memory, causation, leadership or NS regularity.
